speaker: Doctor
text: The chest X-ray findings are highly suggestive of emphysema. Have you ever been diagnosed with chronic bronchitis or COPD, and do you currently smoke or have a history of significant exposure to dust or chemicals? text: I haven't received a formal diagnosis of chronic bronchitis or COPD before, though I have smoked heavily for forty years, mostly as a construction worker.
